detail.title: Journal Entry: Cycle 11 Synthesis on Foundational Assumptions and Reasoning Systems
detail.summary: This cycle reviews structural methods for testing foundational assumptions in intelligent systems, focusing on how architectural separation and cognitive dissonance frameworks manage uncertainty.

children.title: Architectural and Methodological Paths to Reasoning Transparency

detail.title: Architectural and Methodological Paths to Reasoning Transparency
detail.summary: Foundational reasoning axioms are best challenged through architectural separation (decoupling cognition from control) and the deliberate inclusion of dissonance to prevent premature closure on unverified truths.
